idea-plugin.name: SeleniumIQ - AI-Powered Test Automation
idea-plugin.description:
SeleniumIQ — AI-Powered Test Automation

Selenium tests that fix themselves. SeleniumIQ brings artificial intelligence to Selenium WebDriver — generating stable locators, self-healing broken selectors, predicting flaky tests before they fail, and providing time-travel debugging with full DOM snapshots.

Key Features

  • AI Locator Generation — Smart locators with stability scores for maximum resilience
  • Self-Healing Locators — Automatically repairs broken selectors when the DOM changes
  • Flakiness Prediction — 86% accuracy across 25+ test health metrics
  • Cross-Browser Testing — Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge support
  • Time-Travel Debugging — Replay test executions with DOM snapshots at each step
  • Page Object Generation — Auto-generate page object classes from web pages
  • Multi-Language — Java, Python, and JavaScript bindings

Why SeleniumIQ?

Test maintenance consumes 60–80% of automation effort. SeleniumIQ's AI reduces maintenance by auto-healing broken locators and predicting which tests will become flaky — before they disrupt your pipeline.

Free vs Pro

  • Free: AI locator generation, basic self-healing, cross-browser testing, intelligent waits
  • Pro: Visual regression testing (Percy/Applitools), performance analyzer, cloud platform integration (BrowserStack, Sauce Labs), test management integration (Jira/TestRail), compliance reporting, and data-driven testing
